name: Do I need a permit for a room addition in Berkeley?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a room addition in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, any significant room expansion in Berkeley, or any other city we serve like Oakland or Albany, requires building permits. These permits ensure that your addition meets local building codes, zoning ordinances, and safety standards. Attempting to build without proper permits can lead to fines, difficulties selling your home, and potential safety hazards. Frasheski Construction handles the entire permitting process for our clients.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, room additions in Berkeley and other service areas require building permits to ensure code compliance and safety.
